title: Turkish Copula Suffixes ('To Be')
summary: Predicate personal suffixes attached to nouns and adjectives.
explanation: In Turkish, 'to be' is expressed via suffixes attached directly to words (-im, -sin, -dir...), following 4-way vowel harmony.

common_error_explanations.err_tr_cop_1: Apply 4-way vowel harmony to copula suffixes.
